### Release Notes for [4.6.0](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/milestone/195)



### 4.6.0

- Total issues resolved: **0**
- Total pull requests resolved: **10**
- Total contributors: **7**

#### New Features

 - [7564: Have schema introspection map to immutable date types](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/pull/7564) thanks to @derrabus
 - [7345: Add QueryBuilder::addComment() to attach SQL comments to generated queries](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/pull/7345) thanks to @jdecool
 - [7342: Add `TypeRegistry` to `Configuration` and use it in all internal type resolution](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/pull/7342) thanks to @GromNaN

#### Deprecations

 - [7591: Deprecate omitting unique constraint clustering](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/pull/7591) thanks to @morozov
 - [7581: Document and clean up support for Database versions](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/pull/7581) thanks to @derrabus
 - [7575: Deprecate the mutable date/time types](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/pull/7575) thanks to @derrabus

#### Performance

 - [7596: [GH-7595] Alternative DBAL SQL Parser performance improvements.](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/pull/7596) thanks to @ToonvanDoornShopwoks

#### Static analysis

 - [7526: Precise Name::toString as non-empty-string](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/pull/7526) thanks to @VincentLanglet

#### CI

 - [7599: Remove unused OCI8 exception and AppVeyor configurations](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/pull/7599) thanks to @andreybolonin

#### Test Suite

 - [7594: Add clarifying comment about SQL comments and harden test suite](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/pull/7594) thanks to @derrabus

hot_issues.title: Doctrine ORM tries to recreate partial indexes with the same definition every time.
Add microseconds support on datetime/time types
MySQL + deadlock leads to `SAVEPOINT DOCTRINE_x does not exist`
Migrations not ever in sync with the DB
Expose the underlying statement in DBAL statements
